structured.answer: I'd go with Harel, the "מניות" track (קופה 8522). Harel is a big name I know, it was first on the list, its fee is the cheapest I saw (0.55%), and it shows the biggest 3-year number I came across, 24.04%. I'm only fairly sure, and I'd want someone to check it before I put money in.

stuck.why: There were 16 buttons and 143 tracks. I didn't know whether to tap 'עוקב מדד S&P 500' because my friends talk about the S&P, or just scroll.
Every company has the same names over and over (כללי, מניות, S&P 500, משולב סחיר). After a few screens it all looked the same and I stopped at screen 5.
Lots of rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number, so I couldn't compare those, including Harel's 'עוקב מדדי מניות'.

stuck.where: Choosing between Harel מניות and Harel S&P 500
stuck.why: The S&P one is what my friends mean, but מניות shows 24.04% against 13.7%, so I took the bigger number.

findings.what: Too many look-alike options (143 tracks, same track names at every company). I can't tell them apart, and I almost closed it to do nothing.
Fees only as small percents (0.55%, 0.73%). No shekel amount, so they all feel like nothing.
Many rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, so I can't compare them.
I didn't get what the circles and the מט"ח percent mean. I guessed at the colours.
Two fees (מהחיסכון / מההפקדות) and I didn't know which one counts.
Returns are 'לפני דמי ניהול', so the number I'm judging by isn't what I'd get.
Nothing tells me what to do next or how to actually open the fund.
'עוד לא דווח' with an orange warning icon put me off that row.
